title: Annual Income Tax Return for Individuals Earning Income from Business/Profession (Micro and Small taxpayers)

period.label: Item 1 — Month the short period ends

validation.how: Field labels turn red only; messages are listed in a 'Needs review' section after Part II, and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

findings.now: The year box is free text and stays editable after the library tile set the year; Save draft under a different year overwrites any saved Draft for that year, and a blank box is saved as year 0.
findings.why: Draft rows are keyed by TIN, form, year and period taken from the draft as it stands, so upsert_from_draft updates whichever row matches the new year.

options.name: Read-only year from the tile
options.detail: Show the year the tile set as text and remove the free-text box, so the draft key cannot change on this page.

options.name: Year combobox limited to free years
options.detail: Offer only the tile's year, or years with no saved Draft, so a save cannot land on another year's row.

options.name: Guard the save
options.detail: Refuse Save draft and Queue when the year differs from the saved key or is blank, instead of writing year 0.

findings.now: The submitted taxpayer email is upper-cased whenever Part V Item 7 or Item 9 holds a value, although the page shows it as typed.
findings.why: to_bir_field_map runs an uppercase pass over every text control, emails included, when part_v_capitalizes() is true, which breaks the rule that the email is never upper-cased.

options.name: Exclude the email keys
options.detail: Skip txtEmaila and txtEmailb in the uppercase pass, as SELECT_CONTROLS already excludes the select controls.

options.name: Block queue with a notice
options.detail: Keep the official capital() behaviour only if the owner accepts it, and show a notice before queueing when Part V triggers it.

findings.now: A short-period return can be queued with any month and year that pass the future-date check; the official alert requiring the current month and year never appears.
findings.why: The Item 1 block of validate_on only checks for future dates, so the official validateCurrentYear rule with the short-period alert text is not ported.

options.name: Port the alert
options.detail: Add the verbatim text 'For short period return, the month should be the current month and the year should be the current year.' to the short-period branch.

options.name: Limit the month buttons
options.detail: When Item 3 is Yes, offer only the current month and year so the invalid state cannot be entered.

findings.now: Five buttons sit in one row: Single, Married, Widow/er, Legally Separated, Not Applicable.
findings.why: Five single-value options are above the four-option limit for button rows, so a combobox is the better control.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Single-select combobox with the five labels in the same row position.

options.name: Vertical radio list
options.detail: A stacked list of five radio rows keeps every label visible without a dropdown.

findings.field: Item 1 — Month the short period ends
findings.now: Eleven month buttons labelled 01 to 11 wrap across the row whenever Item 3 is Yes.
findings.why: Eleven values form a list, not a choice row, and buttons waste space where a combobox needs one control.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: One combobox with 01 to 11 in place of the eleven buttons.

options.name: Read-only chip with popup
options.detail: Show the chosen month as text and open the 01 to 11 list on click.

findings.now: Errors only turn the field label red; the messages sit in a Needs review block below Part II, and Queue for submission is greyed out with no message beside it. The Item 8 name and Item 10 phone labels never turn red because their keys differ.
findings.why: field() matches keys 'name' and 'phone' against validation keys 'taxpayer_name' and 'contact_number', so those two highlights never fire and the rest depend on a panel far from the input.

options.name: Inline message under each field
options.detail: Render the message text beneath the input, not only a red label.

options.name: Jump-to-error list
options.detail: Move Needs review above Part I and make each entry scroll to its field.

options.name: Fix the highlight keys
options.detail: Pass 'taxpayer_name' and 'contact_number' as the error keys for the name and phone fields.

findings.now: The row reads 'Item 18 — ATC: II012' with only the code, while the description helper exists and is used only by the print sheet.
findings.why: The user cannot tell which of the seven codes was derived from Items 11 and 12 without memorising the table.

options.name: Code and description
options.detail: Show the code with its text from form_1701ms_atc_description in the same row.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the code and description as a chip that says it was set from Items 11 and 12.

findings.now: Schedules 10A, 10B, 13 and 20 take one total per column, with no rows for the descriptions the official View Details popups collect.
findings.why: The official validationSpecify10A check (Empty fields are not allowed) needs a description with each amount, and the port neither asks for it nor reproduces the check.

options.name: Description and amount rows
options.detail: Add rows with an Add row button under each schedule and sum them into the total.

options.name: Required description per total
options.detail: Keep one total per schedule and require a description when the amount is non-zero, as the official check does.

findings.now: The Part V Item 7 and Item 9 messages use the second official wording only; the official first wording 'Part V - Item 7B Foreign Tax Amount ...' and 'Part V - Item 9B Amount ...' never appears.
findings.why: The official validate() lists both wordings, and the port emits only the non-B form.

options.name: Use the official wording
options.detail: Emit the Item 7B and Item 9B texts for the first occurrence, matching the official source order.

options.name: Record the deviation
options.detail: If the second wording was chosen on purpose, record it as a documented deviation next to the validation inventory.

findings.now: When every check passes, no line says 'Validation successful. Click on Edit if you wish to modify your entries.'
findings.why: The official validate() shows this alert on success, and the page renders only the error list.

options.name: Success line in the review slot
options.detail: Show the verbatim success text where the Needs review list would be when there are no errors.

options.name: Status bar message
options.detail: Show the same text in the status message bar after a clean check.
